note: TUBA4A mutations clearly cause autosomal dominant spastic ataxia (SPAX11) with spasticity and ataxia, though cerebellar atrophy on MRI is reported as slight or absent in some cohorts.

evidence.text: TUBA4A missense variants cause spastic ataxia, but brain MRI in affected individuals demonstrated slight or absent cerebellar atrophy.

source.title: A new genetic cause of spastic ataxia: the p.Glu415Lys variant in TUBA4A
source.quote: Brain MRI showed slight or absent cerebellar atrophy. The clinical picture is different …

evidence.text: A multicenter cohort confirmed that monoallelic TUBA4A variants cause spasticity and/or cerebellar ataxia in 12 reported individuals.

source.title: De novo and inherited monoallelic variants in TUBA4A cause ataxia and spasticity
source.quote: Taken together, we report 12 patients presenting with spasticity and/or cerebellar ataxia and harbouring a predicted pathogenic TUBA4A missense mutation

numbers.metric: patients presenting with spasticity and/or cerebellar ataxia
